_comment: Curated asset catalog for the Modelware Asset Navigator. Hand-maintained source of truth for titles, groups, audiences, icons, descriptions and tags. The CI build (build-manifest.mjs) merges this with per-file git versions to produce assets-manifest.json, which index.html renders. To add an asset: add a <meta name="mw-asset" content="true"> tag to its main HTML file AND add an entry here (href must match the file path from the repo root). Sub-pages of an app do NOT get tagged and do NOT appear here.
